install_steps: Or: sudo add-apt-repository ppa:cncf-buildpacks/pack-cli && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install pack-cli (Debian/Ubuntu)
Requires a running Docker daemon or compatible container runtime
note: The binary is `pack` (the Debian package is `pack-cli`). If no Docker daemon is available locally, point DOCKER_HOST at a remote one. Set a default builder once with `pack config default-builder paketobuildpacks/builder-jammy-base` to skip --builder flags.
